sections.title: The letters th
paragraphs: The letters th make two sounds. The main sound is heard in (think) /θɪŋk/, which means to use your mind. It is a consonant, a sound made when the mouth narrows the air.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Put the tip of your tongue against your upper teeth. Blow air through the small gap. The first sound is voiceless, a sound where the voice is off. Your throat does not shake. The other sound is voiced, a sound where the voice is on. Put a hand on your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: When to use each
paragraphs: The letters th are voiceless at the end of words, as in (bath) /bɑːθ/. They are also voiceless in most main words, such as (think) /θɪŋk/. The letters th are voiced between vowels, as in (father) /fɑː.ðə/. They are also voiced in little grammar words, such as (this) /ðɪs/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not bite your lower lip like f in fit. Do not push your tongue against the roof of your mouth like s in sit. Place your tongue gently between your front teeth and blow air softly.
